title: French Kale Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy French-inspired stir fry made with curly kale and a crunchy twist.

ingredients.name: fry mix
ingredients.notes: such as onion, bell pepper, and carrots

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the German sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the fry mix and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the curly kale to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Return the sausage to the skillet and stir to combine.
Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste.
